Reference: 2) General Administration Department Government Decision No. SRV 2015 / P.No.303 / Ka.12, D. 12.09.2016 2) Department of Law & Justice Serial Order Date 08.07.2026

As per the relevant orders of the Department of Law and Justice, the Superintendent at the Establishment of the Office of the Commissioner of Charity, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) cadre personnel were provisionally promoted to the posts of Administrative Officer in the Select List of the year 2025-26, Group-B (Gazetted) cadre in the quota of regular promotion. Since the employees mentioned in the table below in this selection list have declined the promotion permanently / temporarily, their name is being excluded from the 2025-26 selection list.

Since the aforesaid employees have refused promotion, the Office of the Charity Commissioner shall proceed against them in accordance with the instructions in the relevant Government Decision dated 12.09.2016 of the General Administration Department.
